target_customer: iPad owners, especially families and friends playing together on one device
problem: Tablet games were mostly single player; Koduco made iPad games built around several people collaborating on the same device.
business_model: Paid or free iPad app sales (per YC description; pricing not found)

founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no biography there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Native iPad games with shared screen multiplayer were ordinary iOS game development in 2010, new only because the iPad had just launched.

defensibility.rationale: Games are easily imitated and no sources show a technical, data or network advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows any incumbent response.

market_need_then: The iPad launched in April 2010, creating a new platform with few native games, and the shared screen format suited the device; no source quantifies demand.

branding.domain_note: koduco.com now redirects to a domain broker listing (observed on fetch), so the domain is for sale.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search returned no results for Koduco; no coverage or community is documented.

outcome_analysis: Koduco was a two founder Summer 2010 studio making collaborative same device iPad games, and public sources give no traction figures, funding or closure notice. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so failure factors stay empty, and only the YC listing and a for sale domain show it is no longer operating.
